description: DAVE - Measuring run on Mittellandkanal in Hannover, Germany - Canal is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. The dataset was collected during a measurement run on the Mittellandkanal in Hanover, Germany. The data is provided in the ros2bag mcap storage format. The bag files contain data from the following sensors Lidar Camera GPS Wind The bag files can be played using the free foxglove studio software. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/BIN. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
